section_2.title: HND — Higher National Diploma
section_2.description: A two-year Level 5 qualification focused on practical higher education, often used as a stepping stone into the final year of a degree.

section_3.title: What is HND?
section_3.description: This page follows the Foundation Year structure: clear, practical and focused on what students need before applying.

cards.title: What you study
cards.description: Subject-focused modules that build academic knowledge, practical skills and confidence for your next step.

cards.title: Who it suits
cards.description: Mature students, career changers and learners who want a recognised route without overcomplicating the decision.

cards.title: What you receive
cards.description: Higher National Diploma when you complete the course, depending on provider rules and successful completion.

cards.title: Next step
cards.description: Use the qualification to progress academically, apply for work or top up where the route allows.

section_4.title: Entry requirements and progression.
section_4.description: Most adult learners need a simple answer: can I enter, can I fund it, and where can it take me?

cards.title: What universities usually check
points: Usually Level 3, HNC or relevant experience
Some courses accept mature students with work history

cards.title: Where this route can lead
points: Top-up to a full Bachelor’s degree

cards.title: Check before committing
points: Previous higher education study can affect funding.
Part-time, online and weekend routes may be assessed differently.
Use the eligibility checker before applying.

section_5.title: Can Student Finance support this route?

cards.title: Tuition
cards.description: May be covered if the course is designated.

cards.title: Living costs
cards.description: Depends on mode, intensity, residence and course type.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for mature students?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many providers assess adults through qualifications, work experience, motivation and English level.

faqs.question: Can YStudy help me choose between this and a degree?
faqs.answer: Yes. We compare the route against Foundation Year, HND, Top-Up and full Bachelor’s options.

faqs.question: Should I apply before checking funding?
faqs.answer: No. Check eligibility first, especially if you studied before or need maintenance support.
